# Popover

Display actions on-click, related to the clicked component on a content cell.
See [Popover guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/popover/design/)

The `ds-popover` and `ds-popover-arrow` classes only provide basic styling, positioning must be handled by a library such as [Popper.js](https://popper.js.org/).

To build a Popover Menu, use the <LinkTo kind="Components/List" story="docs">List</LinkTo> component.

<Canvas of={PopoverStories.Basic} />

```css
.h-140 {
  height: 140px;
}
.m-1 {
  margin-left: 1rem;
}
```
